scope: Persistent city logistics environment before operating-day activation; internal freeze only
location_unit: One independent/provisional house site, one source-identified apartment complex, one depot spatial group, or one AFDC charging location
terminal_ownership: Only selected origin egress and destination ingress may be materialized; no terminal through-routing
connector_cost: Retain geometric length and time_s_per_inverse_kph=3.6*length_m. Vehicle/scenario connector speed is a Stage2 input; no test speed is frozen as observed data.
residential_units: Nullable auxiliary source-supported estimate, separate from location count, daily customers, packages and realized demand
scope_ambiguity: Preserve sources, clear uncertain operational unit estimates, mark pending under the same source-owner rule in every city; no manual merges
eligibility: Stage1 eligibility is a source/access/parameter gate; it is not an activated customer or station
unknown_access: Retained pending, with explicit reason; no arbitrary 1km deletion
reference_vehicle: Charging compatibility/caps are an explicit reference profile; all native member/configuration evidence remains available
provenance: Frozen input archive, source/code/policy/output hashes, relative component file map and independent saved-file verification
